simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to דֶּתֶא (H1883) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: דֶּתֶא (detheʼ) means tender grass. First listed occurrence: Dan 4 12.

definitions.full: H1883. dethe [ דֶּ֫תֶא ] noun [masculine] grass (so ᵑ7 Syriac; Biblical Hebrew דֶּשֶׁא ); — emphatic דִּתְאָא Dan 4:12 ; 4:20 .
